patch_description:
The original implementation corrupts rows during recursion: `as_completed()` returns futures in arbitrary order but writes them using a sequential `i`, losing the source-row mapping. It also adds/removes an `original_index` column, merges dataframes after row-specific column permutations, returns an empty ordering list, and finally sorts values independently of the reported per-row column layout. These behaviors can alter row identity and violate validation invariants.

This replacement preserves every original cell, row, column, index, and shape. It builds bounded candidate column layouts using serialized cell values, scores candidates with the exact sorted-string adjacent-LCP Trie objective, and returns valid per-row column orderings. It supports mixed values and missing values without modifying stored values, honors merge groups as contiguous column blocks, and applies one-way dependency ordering where possible.
